affpool.reason: only 1 distinct prefix(es) in this stratum; homogeneity needs >= 3 prefixes sharing a cell

depth_1.omega2_note: At depth 1 the root pool stays size 1, so parent_nu == root_nu and the bucket is constant within a tree. The (depth, action) groups this omega^2 is computed over therefore draw ALL of their bucket variation from between trees and between dialogues -- it is the between-tree contrast, not a within-edge one, and it is exactly the component p_var.md 7.3 showed to be ~90 % prefix/dialogue identity. The edge-demeaned counterpart is 0 by construction.
